strategies.name: Opening Breakout
strategies.when: Once a day: the 09:30–09:45 New York candle.
steps: Any chart from 1m to 15m, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M8 on.
Mark the pre-open high: the highest price from 08:00 to 09:30 New York.
The 09:30 15m candle is a BuBC: it closes above the previous 15m candle’s high.
It also closes ABOVE the pre-open high. If it closes inside the pre-open range, no trade.
At the first 15m close below the 09:30 candle’s low. Otherwise out at the 16:59 close.

Optional. If the next 15m candle (09:45–10:00) closes above the 09:30 candle’s high, and price is more than 5 pts above your stop, buy 1 more contract at its close. Same stop price, same exit. The extra contract made money in 2023–24, 2025 and 2026. With it, 1 MNQ base: net $10,824 → $15,836 · max drawdown $906 → $1,305 · PF 1.68 → 1.74.
strategies.why: Buyers broke the whole pre-open range on the opening drive. When that holds, the day tends to keep going up.
strategies.watch: The pre-open filter was picked from 14 filters: expect it a bit weaker live. 1m / 5m CDL entries and limits were tested and are not better. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 3.8 over all the data). Release 2026-11 master numbers, t-score per day.
strategies.tgt: 1:3 RR or a close below the 09:30 low
strategies.plain: Think of 08:00–09:30 as a fence. When the first 15-minute candle of the cash open jumps over the fence and closes above it, buyers broke out of the yard. We buy that close.
strategies.mmm: 09:30 BuBC above the pre-open high

strategies.name: Level Bounce Max
strategies.when: The CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York.
steps: 1 minute, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M6 on. The levels are drawn for you.
Mark the levels: daily open 18:00, PDH / PDL, overnight high / low (18:00–09:30), Asia high / low (18:00–02:00), 09:30 open, prior 16:00 close, the newest live H1 / H4 GMC.
The 15m MMM structure is up (the last 15m flip was a CDL) on the last closed 15m candle.
A 1m CDL: the 1m structure flips up, and its new PO4 T1 is within 15 pts of a level.
A bullish GMC formed between the PO4 T1 and the CDL with its level inside that range (a gap).
At the CDL close, place a buy limit at the PO4 T1 (fills 1 tick through). Cancel at +80 pts untouched or after 60 candles. A candle closing below the T1 does not cancel it.
1:5 (200 pts). No early exit. Out at the 16:59 close if nothing hits. One trade at a time.

Optional. Once the trade has been up half its stop (+0.5R), if price comes back to your entry, buy 1 more contract at the close of that 15m candle, if the trade is still open. Same stop price, same exit. Once per trade. The extra contract made money in 2023–24, 2025 and 2026. With it, 1 MNQ base: net $7,969 → $11,826 · max drawdown $1,238 → $1,578 · PF 1.59 → 1.68.
strategies.why: The level is real: the same 1m long with no level near loses.
strategies.watch: Few trades in 2026 (12, only the real 1-min months). Paper-trade it first. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 3.2 over all the data). Release 2026-11 master numbers, t-score per day.
strategies.plain: The 15m trend is up. On 1m, price flips up right next to a big level. We put a buy order where the flip started (the T1) and let price come back to us.
strategies.mmm: Level Retest A · Max Profit

strategies.name: Level Bounce Safe
strategies.when: The CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York.
steps: 1 minute, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M7 on. The levels are drawn for you.
Mark the same levels as C.M6.
Same as C.M6: 15m trend up, 1m CDL with its PO4 T1 within 15 pts of a level, no gap.
Buy limit at the PO4 T1, placed at the CDL close. Cancel at +70 pts untouched or after 60 candles.
Max’s 2-candle exit: after a 1m close below the T1 (candle V), get out when a later candle closes below V’s low. A close back above the T1 resets it.
1:5 (175 pts). Out at the 16:59 close if nothing hits. One trade at a time.

strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, X.M4 on. Read only CLOSED candles.
A 3rd or later break of the same trend: a 15m candle closes past the expander box (LDx2+ for longs, SDx2+ for shorts). The new PO4 is T3 or higher.
Yesterday’s daily candle points your way: green for longs, red for shorts.
NQ / MNQ: the break candle already closed OUTSIDE the live daily XB on the break side (above its high for longs, below its low for shorts). That trade chases a move that already left.
Market order at the close of that break candle.
1.5 × ATR(14) of the 15m chart, away from the entry.
Take half off at +0.5R and move the stop to entry. The runner goes to the first opposite break or 1:6.
strategies.why: A trend that beat the other side three times keeps trapping the traders who fade it.
strategies.watch: Numbers = every hour except 00:00–02:00. Lost money in 2023.
strategies.plain: A trend that already beat the other side twice breaks a 3rd time. Late breakers keep trapping the traders who fade them. We join at the close and bank half early.

strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M3 on.
A bullish GMC: candle 2 closes above candle 1’s high and candle 3’s low stays above candle 1’s high (a gap).
Market order at the close of candle 3.
1 × ATR(14) of the 15m chart below the entry.
Half off at +0.75R, stop to entry. The runner goes to 1:3.

Price touches the H1 UPG gap for the first time.
The first MMM PRO FVA reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level.
No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
Limit order at the reversal box edge: its top for longs, its bottom for shorts. The first touch fills.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A candle closes back below the reversal box (long) / above it (short): out at that close.
After the first opposite candle, wait for a BC in profit, then move the stop to that pullback low / high.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: A UPG gap is a hole price left in a hurry. When price comes back to fill it, the side that made the gap usually defends it again.
strategies.watch: Many trades, thin edge: it needs low costs and patience. Lost money in 2025.
strategies.plain: Price falls into an H1 gap and turns. The turn leaves a small box on 5m. We wait at the edge of that box with a limit, like a goalkeeper on the line.

strategies.name: 1m NY AM Long · 2 Green MMPD Candles
strategies.when: Every ▲ arrow setup, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: 1 minute, MMPD Lite (length 27, auto), arrows and background on.
A ▲ arrow: the MMPD body climbs back above 20 after the red background.
Skip if the red background before the arrow was pure: every price candle inside it was red.
A bullish BC closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC (the first one within 30 candles; after a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms the next one).
Within 10 candles: 2 green MMPD candles in a row. Price must stay above that bearish BC open.
Buy at the close of the 2nd green MMPD candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
Anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time, never add.
strategies.why: The MMPD left the red background (sellers ran out) and two green MMPD candles confirm buyers are pushing. A quick 1:1 target banks the first push.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge, and not re-checked under the MMM Testing Standard (Release 2026-11). Skip the trade when the red background before the arrow was pure (only red candles): those longs lose. Busy: about 38 trades a month, up to 8 losses in a row. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 2.3 over all the data).
strategies.plain: Think of the red background as a dam. When the MMPD climbs out of it and two green MMPD candles in a row show the water is really flowing, we buy and take a quick 50 points.
strategies.mmm: ▲ arrow → setup BC → 2 green MMPD candles → buy · 1:1

strategies.name: 2m NY AM Long · First Setup · Lock 1R + STRONG2
strategies.when: The first setup after each ▲ arrow, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: 2 minutes, MMPD Lite (length 27, auto), plus MMM PRO c for the XD block.
The FIRST bullish BC that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC, within 30 candles of the arrow.
Buy at its close. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
At +100 pts (2R) move the stop to entry +51 pts (1R + fees). Then STRONG2: at each new bullish BC, stop to the low of the bigger-body BC of the last two.
A candle closes below the XD block that was under price at entry. Or 16:00 New York.
strategies.why: The first BC through the last bearish BC open is the first real push out of the background. Letting it run catches the trend days.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge, and not re-checked under the MMM Testing Standard (Release 2026-11). Big winners, long losing runs (up to 14 in a row). Get out if a candle closes below the XD block that was under price at entry. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 2.2 over all the data).
strategies.plain: The first break after the dam opens is the cleanest. We buy it, lock 1R once it runs 2R, and let the strongest candles carry the stop up.
strategies.mmm: ▲ arrow → 1st setup BC → buy · lock 1R at +2R → STRONG2 trail

strategies.name: 15m NY AM Long · 1 Green MMPD Candle · STRONG2
strategies.when: Every ▲ arrow setup confirmed by a green MMPD candle, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: A bullish BC closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC (every setup while the arrow lives).
Within 10 candles: 1 green MMPD candle. Price must stay above that bearish BC open.
Buy at the close of the confirm candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
The lowest low of the entry candle and the 2 before it, minus 2 pts. Size the trade so this = your risk.
STRONG2: from the 2nd bullish BC after entry, stop to the low of the bigger-body BC of the last two.
An opposite (short) setup prints. Or 16:00 New York.
strategies.why: One green MMPD candle shows buyers took over on the slower chart. The structure stop sits under the last 3 candles, so losses stay small.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge: its t-score per day is below 3.0 (MMM Testing Standard). Release 2026-11 master numbers.
strategies.tgt: STRONG2 trail · out on an opposite setup
strategies.plain: On 15 minutes the MMPD moves slowly, so one green MMPD candle is enough proof. We use a tight structure stop and let the strongest candles move it up.
strategies.mmm: ▲ arrow → setup BC → 1 green MMPD candle → buy · structure stop · STRONG2

strategies.name: 15m NY AM Long + Short · 1 MMPD Candle · Lock BE
strategies.when: Every arrow setup confirmed by 1 MMPD candle, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: A ▲ arrow for longs, a ▼ arrow for shorts.
A BC closes past the OPEN of the last opposite BC (every setup while the arrow lives).
Within 10 candles: 1 green MMPD candle (longs) or 1 red / pink MMPD candle (shorts).
At the close of the confirm candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
At +50 pts (1R) stop to entry + 1 pt. Then STRONG2.
A BC against you closes past the arrow candle’s low (long) or high (short). Or 16:00 New York.
strategies.why: Shorts add trades in down markets. The arrow-candle exit cuts the trades where the arrow fails.
strategies.watch: Closed at 16:00 it lost a little in 2023: watch it. Held past 16:00 it made money every year. Lost money in 2023. t-score 1.9 over all the data.
strategies.tgt: lock BE at +1R, then STRONG2 trail
strategies.plain: The same 15-minute idea both ways, with a 50 point stop moved to breakeven once the trade is up 1R.
strategies.mmm: arrow → setup BC → 1 MMPD candle → enter · BE at +1R · STRONG2

strategies.name: 1h Long · Swing · STRONG2
strategies.when: The first setup after each ▲ arrow, any hour (swing).
steps: The first bullish BC that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC, within 30 candles of the arrow.
The lowest low of the entry candle and the 2 before it, minus 2 pts.
STRONG2 trail from the first bullish BC that closes in profit. No target.
Swing trade: holds overnight (about 15 hours on average).
strategies.why: Hourly arrows catch the bigger swings. The STRONG2 trail keeps the trade while each new push is strong.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge, and not re-checked under the MMM Testing Standard (Release 2026-11). Holds overnight (about 15 hours on average). Only for accounts that allow it. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 2.1 over all the data).
strategies.plain: The slow version: one-hour arrows, a structure stop, and a trail that holds the trade overnight while the trend lasts.
strategies.mmm: 1h ▲ arrow → 1st setup BC → buy · structure stop · STRONG2

strategies.name: 4h Short · Swing · MAX EXIT
strategies.when: The first setup after each ▼ arrow, any hour (swing).
steps: A ▼ arrow: the MMPD body drops below 80 after the green background.
The first bearish BC that closes below the OPEN of the last bullish BC, within 30 candles of the arrow.
MAX EXIT: when the MMPD drops to 50 or below and then closes back at 50 or above, or when the arrow ends.
Swing trade: holds overnight (about 28 hours on average).
strategies.why: Four-hour sell-offs are fast. The few winners are big (about 6.6R on average) and pay for the many small losses.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge: its t-score per day is below 3.0 (MMM Testing Standard). Release 2026-11 master numbers.
strategies.plain: The 4-hour sell: when the MMPD drops out of the green background and the first bearish BC breaks the last bullish BC open, we sell and ride it until the MMPD bounces back above 50.
strategies.mmm: 4h ▼ arrow → 1st setup BC → sell · 50 pt stop · MAX EXIT

strategies.name: 2m NY AM Long · A · BC Break After the ▲ Arrow
strategies.when: Every ▲ arrow on a GREEN or PINK MMPD candle, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: 2 minutes, MMPD Lite (length 27, auto), arrows and background on.
A ▲ arrow on a GREEN or PINK MMPD candle. Skip it on PALE GREEN.
A bullish BC closes above the HIGH of the last bearish BC. It can come before the arrow (after the lowest candle of the red background) or after it.
Buy at the close once both the arrow and the break are in. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
If price closes below the XD box (the lowest candle of the red background) before you enter, skip it.
Anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time, never add.
strategies.why: The arrow shows the sellers ran out of fuel. A body close above the last bearish BC high shows the buyers took the last wall the sellers built.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge, and not re-checked under the MMM Testing Standard (Release 2026-11). About 20 trades a month, up to 12 losses in a row. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 2.3 over all the data).
strategies.plain: The red background is the dam. The ▲ arrow says the water is leaving it. When a bullish BC closes above the top of the last bearish BC, the buyers broke the last wall: we buy and aim for twice our risk.
strategies.mmm: ▲ arrow (GREEN / PINK) → BuBC above the last BeBC high → buy · 50 pts · 1:2

strategies.name: 2m NY AM Long · A+ · Wait for an MMPD Open Above 50
strategies.when: Every ▲ arrow on a GREEN or PINK MMPD candle, after an MMPD open above 50, 09:30–11:30 New York.
steps: 2 minutes, MMPD Lite (length 27, auto), arrows and background on.
A ▲ arrow on a GREEN or PINK MMPD candle. Skip it on PALE GREEN.
Wait for an MMPD candle that OPENS above 50, while the arrow still lives.
A bullish BC closes above the HIGH of the last bearish BC (before or after the arrow).
Buy at the close once the arrow, the MMPD open above 50 and the break are all in. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York.
If price closes below the XD box before you enter, skip it.
Anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time, never add.
strategies.why: An MMPD open above 50 proves the turn is real before you risk money. It skips the weak arrows that die before the halfway line.
strategies.watch: Watch · not in MMM Pro Edge, and not re-checked under the MMM Testing Standard (Release 2026-11). About 13 trades a month, up to 10 losses in a row. Made money in all 4 years (t-score 2.4 over all the data).
strategies.plain: Same dam as A, but we wait until the MMPD candle opens above 50: the water is already over the halfway mark. Fewer trades, better ones.
strategies.mmm: ▲ arrow (GREEN / PINK) → MMPD opens above 50 → BuBC above the last BeBC high → buy · 45 pts · 1:2

rejected.title: Don’t trade the flip (CDS / CDL) break candle

rejected.title: Don’t enter on an H1 / H4 AFs at a GMC, GMP or PO4 level (setup 1)
rejected.why: The level reaction alone has no edge.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the GMC pullback system
rejected.why: 0 of 43,880 combos were strong in 2022–25 and in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade eBlock, iBlock or balanced block touches as a system
rejected.why: Limits at the blocks lose in 2022–25 and in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t pick blocks by hold %, volume, delta or POC
rejected.why: Hold % moves with WHEN and HOW price touches (07:00–10:00 NY breaks boxes, deep and high-volume touches break boxes) and random boxes move the same way.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1H GMC
rejected.why: Don’t trade 1H GMC because its edge faded to about zero in 2026 while volatility doubled (daily ATR 274 → 481 pts).

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1m, 2m or 5m breaks
rejected.why: Costs eat the edge: 1 pt is 0.2R on a 5 pt stop.

rejected.title: Don’t fade MMPD extremes
rejected.why: Extremes mean momentum, not exhaustion, on 15m NQ.

rejected.title: Don’t use the removed gates
rejected.why: t-score below 2 in 2022–25 or in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t chase 60% WR with a fixed 1:2 target
rejected.why: Without ½ out, WR stays near the break-even math.

rejected.title: Don’t trade SWP+ (strong sweeps)
rejected.why: The long edge failed the fresh test.

rejected.title: Don’t hold the 15m CONTRACTION X4 runner to 1:7
rejected.why: It turned negative in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1h zone G0 T1 FLIPs or 1h CONTRACTION close
rejected.why: Negative in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1h GMC c3 BC+
rejected.why: Faded to zero in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t use an LTF stop for an HTF idea (magnifier)
rejected.why: Targets get hit often, but WR collapses.

rejected.title: Don’t wait for an LTF flip after an HTF touch
rejected.why: In 61–68% of signals the HTF target is hit before the LTF flip prints.

rejected.title: Don’t buy eBlock touches after a swing flip
rejected.why: Flips are often fake.

rejected.title: Don’t use Premium / Discount to filter break trades
rejected.why: Breaks need momentum, which lives in premium for longs.

rejected.title: Don’t use deep limits or tight structure stops
rejected.why: A deep fill often means the break already failed.

rejected.title: Don’t expect an exit to fix an entry
rejected.why: No close-based exit beat stop + target on avg RR.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the NQ setups on ES
rejected.why: The edge is NQ-only.

rejected.title: Don’t trade Gamma walls, HA pockets or the opening-break lab
rejected.why: None reached t ≥ 2 in 2022–25 and in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t skip trades because liquidity sits inside the stop
rejected.why: Price often runs to the liquidity, but after the take it turns back about as often as it keeps going.

rejected.title: Don’t move the stop past the liquidity
rejected.why: A wider stop means fewer contracts and the same win rate.

rejected.title: Don’t trade liquidity sweeps or breaks (4H, day, swings, equal and unfinished highs / lows)
rejected.why: About the same as a random entry.

rejected.title: Don’t sell into a liquidity cluster (or buy into a low one)
rejected.why: The stops get taken, but price keeps going as often as it turns.

rejected.title: Level Retest: don’t enter the gap trades at the CDS / CDL close
rejected.why: The gap trades stay weak even at the CDL close (PF 1.15).

rejected.title: Level Retest: don’t exit at the first close back past the PO4 T1
rejected.why: The losses get smaller (−$13 instead of −$79), but about 80% of the trades that later win also close back past the T1 first.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the London 02:00–05:00 or the 1H 09:00 opening candles
rejected.why: The first touch of a candle high / low is a coin flip: about 50% reverse, 50% close through, at every candle.

rejected.title: Touch + reaction vs close through at a level: no edge either way
rejected.why: It is a coin flip: about 50% reverse and 50% close through, at every level and every candle.

rejected.title: Level Retest outside NY AM, on shorts, or at the NY AM / PM / settlement levels
rejected.why: Only NY AM longs work.

rejected.title: Don’t buy the 2nd break after the pullback closed back inside the box
rejected.why: After a close back inside, 54–56% go on to the 2nd break and 41–43% close below the box low first: close to a coin flip.

rejected.title: Don’t short the failed GMC (c3 BuBC → NBCs → close below the block, then below the GMC)
rejected.why: After the entry, about 1.5 BCs follow the trade before an opposite BC, the same as a random entry.

rejected.title: Don’t trade a close past the last GMC + the last NBC or expander block
rejected.why: It acts like entering on a random candle: same WR, same small loss after costs.

rejected.title: Don’t buy the retest of a block after a long range
rejected.why: Price does come back to the edge within 20 candles about 85% of the time, but just as often for a 2–5 candle block as for a 21+ candle one.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the flip (first opposite BC) or its confirmation BC on 5m–4H
rejected.why: After a flip, about 1.5 more BCs follow its way before the old side comes back: a coin flip.

rejected.title: Don’t trade a plain 1H or 4H body close (BuBC / BeBC / AFs) on its own
rejected.why: No hour and no candle type held in 2022–25 and in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade London (02:00–08:00) or pre-market (08:00–09:30) New York
rejected.why: Almost every strategy lost there in 2022–25 and in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t move the EDGE PRO entry past a liquidity cluster
rejected.why: The limit fills only when the signal is wrong (price runs through the cluster).

rejected.title: PRO FVA: retest + 2nd BC on 1m at any level
rejected.why: Loses −0.05 to −0.10 RR a trade. The edge only shows at specific levels and on 5m / 15m.

rejected.title: PRO FVA: the break candle as the entry
rejected.why: Negative almost everywhere.

rejected.title: PRO FVA: 2 more BCs right after the break, then wait for a retest
rejected.why: Price comes back only 25–57% of the time, and the trades that do come are weak.

rejected.title: PRO FVA: lots of back and forth before the touch
rejected.why: Break → NBC → opposite BC → touch was the worst pre-touch pattern.

filters.title: Trade only Asia (18:00–02:00) and NY AM (09:30–13:30)
filters.why: NY AM has the big money’s fuel.

filters.title: Skip 00:00–02:00 (except X.M5)
filters.why: The dead zone before London: no fuel, random pokes.

filters.title: MMPD 27 · Momentum (the default gate)
filters.why: It keeps the CHASE trades, which carry the edge.

filters.title: MMPD 9 · Momentum
filters.why: Similar to 27, a little better in 2026, a little worse in 2022–25.

filters.title: MMPD Delta · Touch first / Touch + 50
filters.why: The only Delta rules with t ≥ 3 in 2022–25 and in 2026.

filters.title: Max 2 open trades
filters.why: Stacked trades lose together on the same move.

filters.title: Yesterday’s daily candle in the trade direction
filters.why: The HTF buyers are already in control.

filters.title: 1h box trend up (C.M4 and C.M5)
filters.why: Removes most choppy days for C.M4 and C.M5.

filters.title: 2+ setups on the same 15m candle
filters.why: More than one reading of control agrees.

filters.title: Volatility stops (ATR) instead of fixed points in fast markets
filters.why: Daily ATR went from 274 to about 481–496 pts in 2026.

filters.title: Live box control: where the last close sits in the box
filters.why: Closing location shows who is winning the tug-of-war.

filters.title: Skip CPI, NFP and FOMC days
filters.why: News spikes make gaps from one big order, not real buying.

filters.title: Liquidity close to price gets taken (use as a guide, not a signal)
filters.why: Distance decides, not the type.

filters.title: Liquidity clusters: expect the wick, don’t trade it
filters.why: Price goes back for them about 8 of 10 times when they are close, the same as one swing at that distance.

filters.title: Level Retest: skip it when a GMC gap sits between the PO4 T1 and the CDL
filters.why: With a gap the retest does not work (PF 1.00).

filters.title: EDGE PRO daily stop: no new trade after 2 losing trades in a day
filters.why: Bad days keep going bad: after the first losses of the day, the next trades are weaker.

filters.title: PRO FVA: no close back inside the broken box for 3 candles
filters.why: The next break goes the same way about 7 times out of 10, and the move is about 2× bigger.

filters.title: PRO FVA: a wick-only retest (no close inside the box)
filters.why: Better than a retest that closes inside, on 5m and 15m, in 2022–25 and in 2026.

filters.title: PRO FVA: a box with an NBC inside
filters.why: It gets retested 71–83% of the time (BC on BC boxes only 49–67%).

filters.title: PRO FVA: UPG gaps as the HTF level
filters.why: The best HTF level in every round of the PRO FVA tests.
